target_vertical: Music Creator Ecosystem & Boutique Sample Labels
ideal_customer_profile: Independent sample pack creators and boutique audio plugin developers.
evaluation_criteria: The score is weighted in code (see 'scoring'): creators on steady views, release consistency, a storefront and audience size; labels on release consistency and catalogue size, with a storefront as a small bonus. Favour creators who release constantly and are consistently watched over those carried by one breakout video. Treat missing figures as unknown, not zero.
